meta.name: stitch-design-taste
meta.description: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成符合高级设计标准的 DESIGN.md 文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目建立严格、高质量的设计规范文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate DESIGN.md files enforcing premium UI standards for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish strict, high-quality design guidelines for your project

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成一份 DESIGN.md 文件，用来指导 Google Stitch 制作界面。文件包含颜色、字体、布局、动效等规则，并明确禁止常见 AI 设计套路（如紫色霓虹、Inter 字体、居中 Hero 等）。
howto.when: 当你需要为 Google Stitch 项目定义一套高级、非通用的设计规范时触发。通常在你描述项目氛围或风格后，Claude 会生成对应的 DESIGN.md。

say.text: 帮我为我的项目生成一份 DESIGN.md，氛围是画廊般通透，不对称布局。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含颜色、字体、布局等规则的设计文件。

say.text: 设计一个高密度仪表盘，字体用 Geist + Geist Mono，禁止紫色。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a DESIGN.md file that guides Google Stitch to create interfaces. The file includes rules for colors, typography, layout, motion, and explicitly bans common AI design clichés (e.g., purple neon, Inter font, centered Hero).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to define a premium, non-generic design system for a Google Stitch project. Typically after you describe the project's vibe or atmosphere.

say_en.text: Generate a DESIGN.md for my project with a gallery-airy atmosphere and asymmetric layout.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a design file with color, typography, layout rules.

say_en.text: Design a high-density dashboard using Geist + Geist Mono, no purple.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a DESIGN.md matching high-density and font constraints.
